disposable_cleanup_scope: Owned campaign schemas and generated module roles only; reusable OAuth identities and secure credential references retained.
historical_one_time_privileged_bootstrap: Identity provisioning, project delegation and SQL-role registration are a separate historical bootstrap phase. Retained evidence of creation/configuration does not establish current account/workspace admin membership.
not_authorized_by_this_record: Delete project, database, IAM identities, service principals or secure credential entries
Infer current credential status or global account/workspace administrative membership
Claim routine refresh or platform acceptance from bootstrap/factory smoke evidence

rotation.ownership_required: The user or designated workspace credential administrator owns renewing or replacing these credentials and updating secure references before expiry; release owner must track that handoff.

routine_identity_scope: Historical actors and their private secure references are reusable inputs. Each future run must freshly validate identity, authorization, expiry and exact target bindings. Full routine platform qualification remains incomplete.
scope: Historical bootstrap references and reusable identity custody; no current acceptance or admin-free lifecycle claim.
